ck: srivatiraciyaprakasika prapava sarvapavananiti prastavitasvapinatasrstin vivicya tarsayitun purvapaksanaha - viputinityatina viputin vivitaprapancakarena pavanan, nahataticakatupatanatvaniti yavat anye tatvapranaturnatonye nantratrastr- prahnana yati svapinateyan srsti syatarhi nanya iti pruyana tvanya iti tato cnayate purvapaksoyaniti evanutaravakyepi trastavyan vikalpiteti virutataya svakapolateva kalpitatvasya vikalpapatanahinEva lapaca purvapaksatvan cnayate ato nayavatyuktan prahnano cakatupatanatvan cakato nityatvan ca purvapaksa eveti prakpave natvarupasya nantratrastrprahnano hrtayan anayasena svatantrasatanantaran vina, svasankalpotarakale svecayEva cakatsrstikaranaticanatranityuktan asti hyatisanartakarvatipi lilayEva krtaprasatatisu asyeyan lilEvetyatikaryakaranayorapetavyapatesa tatatrapi katananyata pahyacakanistasrstirupotpaterantakaranataya prakeva vityananapakavaticaya sahEkyan ? srstO viniscita visesena niscitan niscayo yesan te iti viniscitapatenEva sitantatvan sucitan kritartan tvityetatparyantan purvapaksa eva srutO pokartan kritartan tvayorapi purvapaksa- tayoktatvat ka sitanta ityata aha- svapava iti sa ca krita svapavosya iti vatata kritartan na srsti, kin tu kritapyunatanartanavat svapava evetyapisanti ata eva sruti svapavoyan ityaha yata vasantakale kokilakanasya na racatirancanan palan, napi svasyapurva- sukotpati palan kantasosanarupatvat kintu cutankurasvatana- canitasukotrekenEva tata pakavatopi kritapi svapavikyeveti pava iyanstu visesa:, kokilasya kantasosanenesatayasopi sanpavita pakavati tu sopi nastiti ata eva tevasya ityuktan notenEva hi tivyan hi ‘teva: ityucyate tatuktan sutrakrta- lokavatu lilakEvalyan’ iti sutre tusaptena lokavatayasapavan pakavati visinasti trsyante hi notapavepi svapavateva vayo pavanan catatvatasya noto na cetaptakanatvatpakavatopi sutaran sa nasti ata eva aptakanasya ityaha sruti 13-15
